---
description-meta: "Mobile and desktop shoppers convert alike at every checkout step; the payment step loses the most sessions on every device."
title: "Checkout and repeat purchase: what to fund next quarter"
pagetitle: "Checkout and repeat purchase"
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {
  loadResults,
  dataAlert,
  stepLadder,
  stopShare,
  formatPercent,
  formatPoints,
  formatUsd,
  formatCount,
} from "./charts.js"

results = loadResults({
  conversion: FileAttachment("sources/results/funnel_step_conversion.csv"),
  gaps: FileAttachment("sources/results/funnel_mobile_gap.csv"),
  coverage: FileAttachment("sources/results/profile_coverage.csv"),
  couponDifference: FileAttachment("sources/results/cohort_coupon_difference.csv"),
  paymentTest: FileAttachment("sources/results/sizing_payment_step.csv"),
  mobileOnly: FileAttachment("sources/results/sizing_mobile_only.csv"),
  orderCheck: FileAttachment("sources/results/funnel_checkout_order_check.csv"),
})
```

```{ojs}
//| classes: data-alert-slot
dataAlert(results.missing)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
conversion = results.data.conversion
gaps = results.data.gaps
paymentStop = stopShare(conversion, "add_payment_info")
sessions = results.data.coverage[0]?.sessions
coupon30 = results.data.couponDifference.find((row) => row.window_days === 30) ?? {}
paymentPerPoint = results.data.paymentTest[0]?.revenue_per_point_usd
mobileBest = Math.max(...results.data.mobileOnly.map((row) => row.extra_revenue_usd))
check = results.data.orderCheck[0] ?? {}
shippingFirst = check.shipping_before_checkout / check.checkout_sessions
gapLow = Math.min(...gaps.map((row) => row.gap_low))
gapHigh = Math.max(...gaps.map((row) => row.gap_high))
```

::: {.lede}
Mobile shoppers move through checkout at the same rate as desktop shoppers. The step to fix is
payment: ${formatPercent(paymentStop)} of sessions that add shipping details never add payment
details, on every device.
:::

::: {.source-line}
Google Merchandise Store GA4 sample, 1 November 2020 to 31 January 2021,
${formatCount(sessions)} sessions. Revenue is the sample's US dollars over those 92 days.
:::

```{ojs}
//| classes: slot-ladder
stepLadder(Plot, conversion, {
  width,
  highlightStep: "add_payment_info",
  title: `Mobile and desktop convert alike at every step; ${formatPercent(paymentStop)} stop before adding payment details`,
  subtitle: "Share of sessions at the previous step that reach each step, with 95% intervals. Sessions, 1 Nov 2020 to 31 Jan 2021. Source: GA4 obfuscated sample e-commerce dataset.",
})
```

## Three recommendations

1. **Fund a payment-step fix for all devices, not a mobile-only fix.** Each extra point of
   shipping-to-payment conversion is worth ${formatUsd(paymentPerPoint)} per 92 days. A
   mobile-only fix could add at most ${formatUsd(mobileBest)}, because every mobile minus desktop
   gap lies between ${formatPoints(gapLow)} and ${formatPoints(gapHigh)} points.
2. **Keep coupon-led acquisition, and decide on margin.** Within 30 days,
   ${formatPercent(coupon30.coupon_repeat_rate)} of coupon first-time buyers bought again,
   against ${formatPercent(coupon30.no_coupon_repeat_rate)} of the rest.
3. **Repair two tracking problems before the next funnel review.** In
   ${formatPercent(shippingFirst)} of checkout sessions, shipping details are logged before
   checkout begins.

The [memo](memo.qmd) gives the assumption behind each number and how to test it. The other pages
show the evidence: [checkout funnel](funnel.qmd), [repeat purchase](repeat-purchase.qmd), and
[revenue at stake](revenue.qmd).
